CustomObject.description: Primary store for data-touching Org Loom audit events in the customer's Salesforce org. One row per event that touches Salesforce data (canvas save / load / share, upload, recall, SF connect/disconnect). Workspace-meta events (permission grants, member changes, plan changes, settings flips) live in Org Loom's own database and are not mirrored here. External_Id__c is the Org Loom server-side event id so re-dispatch on retry is idempotent (UPSERT against this field). Security teams can SOQL or report directly on this object; no Org Loom UI required.
CustomObject.label: Orgloom Audit Event
